messages:
maria: Heads-up — we've got multiple inbound leads stuck in the HubSpot → SFDC handoff this morning. Symptoms: missing enrichment, round-robin not assigning, some leads landing in the generic queue. Want to lock down SLAs and a quick patch plan. My suggested SLAs: enrich job triggered within 60s, enrichment complete within 5m, assign to rep within 2m, notify sales slack channel within 1m. Thoughts?

aj: Can you paste an example lead id? I saw a workflow failure in HubSpot earlier. Here is the error from retries:```workflow_id: 3f9
error: 400 bad request - missing email
attempts: 3
last_response: {"message":"validation failed"}```Seems like the workflow doesn't skip invalid records so the Salesforce push fails and then round-robin never runs.

kevin-sales: This matches reports from SDRs — sometimes leads get into "unassigned" for >30m. Quick note: our round-robin counter was persisting in a per-app memory store and got reset during the deploy last night. Need to move to a persistent counter (Redis or Dynamo) or use Salesforce assignment rules instead. Also check mapping: HubSpot lifecycle_stage -> SFDC Lead Status mapping lost the ownership rule.

emily-ops: Agreed on persistence. Also recommend we tag leads that fail enrichment with "needs-enrichment" and run a retry pipeline (Clearbit/InsideView) for 3 retries. For SLAs: I prefer tiers — high-intent (lead_score >= 80): assign within 1m, standard: 5m. We can add Datadog monitors for latency of each step and a composite alert if assign_time > SLA.

maria: Good call on tiers. For immediate fix, can we: 1) add guard to HubSpot workflow to not block (skip if missing email), 2) re-seed round-robin to current last owner so assignment resumes, 3) trigger out-of-band enrichment for recently failed leads. Who owns the hotfix?

aj: I'll own HubSpot workflow changes and the guard. Plan: push a safe rollback-able change by 23:00 PST, then run a manual warm-up to ensure round-robin seed is set. I'll also export the affected leads for manual reassignment. Test plan: create 5 test leads with/without email and verify SFDC lead created + owner assigned.

kevin-sales: I'll update the Salesforce assignment rule as a fallback path so even if HubSpot assignment fails the SFDC rule will pick up based on lead territory + product interest. Also asking ops for a one-time script to reseed the round-robin counter to the last assigned idx.

emily-ops: I'll create the Datadog monitors and an alert playbook in Confluence. Confluence link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/marketing/lead-handoff-slas (will create page). Alerts: page_oncall if assign_time > SLA for 3 consecutive leads, and PagerDuty if >30m. I'll also wire HubSpot webhook delivery failures into the same alert.

sales-bot: Lead-handoff-failure detected: lead_id=LD-20260320-4812 status=failed_handoff source=hubspot attempts=3

maria: Perfect. Two more items: 1) update Playbook in sales enablement with new SLAs and manual reassign steps, 2) ensure inbound routing docs call out the enrichment provider and the failure fallback.

aj: Will update HubSpot workflows + playbook PR by EOD. I'll add test cases and link them to the runbook.

kevin-sales: I'll schedule a short rollout with SDR leads on slack->#sales so we can watch assignment for 2 hours after the fix. Also want a quick retro tomorrow to tighten mapping tests.

emily-ops: I'll provision Redis for the counter in staging and add a smoke test that simulates deploy resets. Also will set metric: lead_handoff_latency{step="assign"} and create dashboards.

maria: Ok team — thanks. Owners: aj (HubSpot workflow + guard + export), kevin-sales (SFDC fallback rule + reseed + sales rollout), emily-ops (monitoring + Redis + alerts). We'll aim for the fix tonight and retro tomorrow 10:00 PST. :thumbsup:

aj: going to schedule the deploy window now.

kevin-sales: thanks — I'll prep an FAQ for SDRs to explain temporary reassignments.

emily-ops: creating the Confluence page and Datadog alerts now.

maria: Closing the thread once PRs are up. Thanks everyone!
